title: Rustup proxy slowdown with Rust-Analyzer
author: stefnotch
body_preview: ### Problem  When Rust-Analyzer runs cargo, then it goes through the rustup proxy. Then, the rustup proxy checks which rust toolchain needs to be used. It then calls the correct version of cargo or rustc.  However, this rustup proxy comes with a quite a bit of overhead. title: no-op cargo build adds latency to binary relaunch on macOS
author: ishermandom
body_preview: ### Problem  On macOS, `cargo build` appears to always rewrite the binary file on disk, even when the contents have not changed.  This has a performance cost: macOS detects the new file as unverified, and runs a malware scan on first launch.
